scientific integrity: The proof supplies an explicit one-parameter admissible family, identifies every active norm facet on the stated interval, factors numerator and denominator exactly, and derives divergence without numerical approximation. Literature comparison was performed at the statement and implication level.
scientific limitations: The theorem concerns the displayed regular-octagonal norm and the 2023 definition of P(X). It proves unboundedness of that supremum but does not classify finiteness on other Banach spaces.
title: Unbounded \(P(X)\) quotient on the regular octagonal Banach plane
